title: Quote vision-md-triage-verdict description so strict YAML parsers accept it
body:
The skills CLI skips `skills/vision-md-triage-verdict/SKILL.md`:

```
⚠ Skipped .../skills/vision-md-triage-verdict/SKILL.md — YAML parse error: Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings at line 2, column 14:
```

**Cause:** the `description:` value is an unquoted plain scalar that contains `: ` ("...next to the per-rule list: restore | ..."). Strict YAML parsers read that as a nested mapping and reject the whole frontmatter, so harnesses drop the skill.

**Fix:** wrap the description in double quotes. The parsed text is the same as before. No other file changes. The other six `SKILL.md` files already parse.

**Proof:**

| Check | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `yaml` parse of all 7 `skills/*/SKILL.md` frontmatters | 6 OK, 1 FAIL | 7 OK |
| `npx skills@latest add <checkout> -l` | `Found 6 skills` + skip warning | `Found 7 skills`, no warning |
